page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are copied as far as legible; the scan is blurred and small, so several Hebrew vowel points and some Latin words in the right column (e.g. "vexillum ferens", "adjectus", "erudientur") are doubtful. Right-column line "Ad dormitandum" and Hebrew forms near the centre fold are uncertain. Hebrew letters on the left margin of the printed lines are partly illegible and were not reconstructed; the transcription of Hebrew roots is approximate. Running head absent. Catchword absent. Line "convend." at the foot is a catchword-like fragment and is kept as printed text.
